title: 喪中はがき・お悔やみの花 水彩
subject_en: Quiet, dignified flowers for mourning and condolence cards, each a separate single flower or small spray, calm muted palette (soft lavender, grey-blue, pale pink, ivory, sage green), no bright colours, no faces, no ribbons. Outlines are closed thin pencil-like lines darker than the fill; light petals are warm cream (#FFF6E0) or faintly tinted, never pure white.
lead: 蓮、菊、百合、桔梗、りんどう。喪中はがき、寒中見舞い、お悔やみのカードに添える、落ち着いた色の花の水彩イラスト12点。登録不要で、そのまま使えます。
items: a single lotus flower, pale pink petals, with one round leaf
a white chrysanthemum with a short stem and two leaves, petals in warm cream
a soft purple chrysanthemum with a short stem and leaves
a single white lily flower on a stem with a bud, petals in warm cream with pale green centre
a bellflower (kikyo) stem with three purple star-shaped blooms
a gentian stem with several deep blue-violet tubular flowers
a short arching stem of three phalaenopsis orchid flowers in ivory and pale pink
a white camellia flower with glossy dark green leaves, petals in warm cream
a lily-of-the-valley stem with small cream bell flowers and two leaves
a closed pale pink lotus bud on a stem beside a small leaf
a small calm bouquet of white lilies and purple chrysanthemums tied with a plain pale ribbon
a sprig of pampas grass with one purple bellflower, calm autumn mood
